meaning.en: Dangers or crises hidden on all sides.
meaning.zh: 到处隐藏着危险。

examples.zh: 表面风平浪静，其实危机四伏。
examples.en: It looks calm on the surface, but danger lurks everywhere.

examples.zh: 这家公司看似繁荣，实则危机四伏。
examples.en: The company seems to be thriving, but it's riddled with hidden risks.

examples.zh: 丛林里危机四伏，千万要小心。
examples.en: The jungle is full of hidden dangers, so be very careful.

meaning.en: To copy a set method exactly; to do the same thing again.
meaning.zh: 原指按照成方炮制中药，今比喻照着现成的样子去做。

examples.zh: 别的城市看到效果不错，纷纷如法炮制。
examples.en: Seeing the good results, other cities followed suit.

examples.zh: 他用这个办法骗了一次，又如法炮制骗了第二次。
examples.en: He pulled the same scam a second time.

examples.zh: 你按我的步骤如法炮制就行了。
examples.en: Just follow my steps exactly.

meaning.en: Fresh water from the source; figuratively, the constant source of new ideas and vitality.
meaning.zh: 从源头流来的活水，比喻事物不断发展、充满活力的根源。

examples.zh: 生活是创作的源头活水。
examples.en: Real life is the wellspring of creative work.

examples.zh: 人才是企业发展的源头活水。
examples.en: Talent is the lifeblood of a company's growth.

examples.zh: 读书是思想的源头活水。
examples.en: Reading is a fresh source for one's thinking.

story.en: Zhu Xi compared a clear square pond to a mind refreshed by reading: 'How can it be so clear? Because living water comes from the source' (问渠那得清如许？为有源头活水来).
story.zh: 朱熹《观书有感》：“问渠那得清如许？为有源头活水来。”

usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“是……的源头活水”。

meaning.en: To be a model for others to follow, especially as a teacher.
meaning.zh: 在人品、学问上作别人学习的榜样。

examples.zh: 教师要为人师表，以身作则。
examples.en: Teachers should be role models and lead by example.

examples.zh: 他三十年为人师表，深受学生爱戴。
examples.en: For thirty years he set an example as a teacher and was loved by his students.

examples.zh: 父母也要为人师表，孩子才会学好。
examples.en: Parents must set a good example too, or children won't learn.

meaning.en: At the point of death; in one's final moments.
meaning.zh: 病重快要死的时候。

examples.zh: 老人在弥留之际，仍然惦记着远方的儿子。
examples.en: On his deathbed, the old man was still thinking of his son far away.

examples.zh: 她在弥留之际留下了遗嘱。
examples.en: She made her will in her final moments.

examples.zh: 弥留之际，他对妻子说了声谢谢。
examples.en: In his last moments, he said thank you to his wife.

story.en: King Cheng of Zhou, near death, said his illness was worsening daily and 'already lingering' (病日臻，既弥留).

date.zh: 西周至战国 · 前11—前3世纪
date.en: Western Zhou to Warring States, 11th–3rd c. BC

usage.en: Adverbial; often 在弥留之际. Formal.
usage.zh: 多作状语，常说“在弥留之际”，书面语。

natural: at the height of one's powers

meaning.en: Like the sun at noon; at the peak of success or power.
meaning.zh: 像太阳正在天空当中，比喻事物正发展到最兴盛的阶段。

equivalents: at the height of one's powers

examples.zh: 那时他的事业如日中天。
examples.en: Back then his career was at its peak.

examples.zh: 这家公司如日中天，市值破万亿。
examples.en: The company is riding high, worth over a trillion.

examples.zh: 正当如日中天之时，她却选择了退役。
examples.en: Just as she was at the height of her powers, she chose to retire.

natural: hit the nail on the head

meaning.en: To hit the nail on the head with a single remark.
meaning.zh: 一句话就说中了要害。

equivalents: hit the nail on the head

examples.zh: 他一语中的，指出了问题的根源。
examples.en: He hit the nail on the head, identifying the root of the problem.

examples.zh: 评委的点评一语中的。
examples.en: The judge's comment was spot on.

examples.zh: 老师一语中的地说出了我作文的毛病。
examples.en: The teacher put her finger on exactly what was wrong with my essay.

meaning.en: (Of the punishment of wrongdoers) to make everyone very glad.
meaning.zh: 坏人受到惩罚或打击，使大家非常痛快。

examples.zh: 贪官被判刑，真是大快人心。
examples.en: The corrupt official's sentence was greeted with delight by all.

examples.zh: 骗子落网的消息大快人心。
examples.en: News of the conman's arrest was very satisfying for everyone.

examples.zh: 这项大快人心的判决赢得了网友点赞。
examples.en: The verdict, a popular one, won wide praise online.

meaning.en: Utterly different.
meaning.zh: 形容差别很大，完全不一样。

examples.zh: 兄弟俩的性格迥然不同。
examples.en: The two brothers are completely different in character.

examples.zh: 南北方的饮食习惯迥然不同。
examples.en: Eating habits in the north and south are worlds apart.

examples.zh: 两位专家得出了迥然不同的结论。
examples.en: The two experts reached totally different conclusions.

meaning.en: A secret or trouble too painful or embarrassing to talk about.
meaning.zh: 难以说出口的隐情或苦衷。

examples.zh: 他一直不肯结婚，或许有什么难言之隐。
examples.en: He's never been willing to marry — perhaps there's something he can't talk about.

examples.zh: 每个人都有自己的难言之隐。
examples.en: Everyone has things they find hard to talk about.

examples.zh: 她辞职是有难言之隐的。
examples.en: There were private reasons behind her resignation.

usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“有难言之隐”。

meaning.en: Great waves wash away the sand; figuratively, a harsh process that leaves only the best.
meaning.zh: 大浪冲洗泥沙，比喻在激烈的竞争或时代洪流中淘汰弱者，留下精华。

equivalents: sift the wheat from the chaff

examples.zh: 大浪淘沙，最后留下来的才是真正的强者。
examples.en: The tide sifts everyone out; only the truly strong are left.

examples.zh: 经过几年大浪淘沙，行业里只剩几家大公司。
examples.en: After years of shake-out, only a few big firms remain in the industry.

examples.zh: 历史大浪淘沙，真正的好作品会流传下来。
examples.en: History sifts everything, and truly great works survive.

meaning.en: Various grades and ranks; a hierarchy of status.
meaning.zh: 指许多等级，多指对人分等级、区别对待。

examples.zh: 别把人分成三六九等。
examples.en: Don't rank people by status.

examples.zh: 在他眼里，客户也分三六九等。
examples.en: In his eyes, even clients come in different grades.

examples.zh: 学校不应该把学生分为三六九等。
examples.en: Schools shouldn't sort pupils into a pecking order.

usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“分成三六九等”。

meaning.en: To be greatly disappointed.
meaning.zh: 原来的希望完全落空，非常失望。

examples.zh: 这部续集让影迷大失所望。
examples.en: The sequel was a huge let-down for fans.

examples.zh: 考试成绩出来，他大失所望。
examples.en: When the results came out, he was bitterly disappointed.

examples.zh: 主队的表现令球迷大失所望。
examples.en: The home team's performance badly disappointed the fans.

usage.en: Predicate; often 令人大失所望.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“令人大失所望”。

meaning.en: Showy but without substance.
meaning.zh: 只开花不结果，比喻外表好看，内容空虚。

examples.zh: 这篇文章辞藻华丽，却华而不实。
examples.en: The essay is flowery but has no substance.

examples.zh: 这款手机功能很多，但大多华而不实。
examples.en: The phone has lots of features, but most are just for show.

examples.zh: 我们要的是实干，不要华而不实的口号。
examples.en: We want real work, not flashy slogans.

story.en: Ning Ying set off to follow the minister Yang Chufu but soon turned back, judging him 'flowering but bearing no fruit — a magnet for resentment' (且华而不实，怨之所聚也).
story.zh: 《左传·文公五年》：宁嬴随阳处父而行，中途而返，说：“且华而不实，怨之所聚也。”

antonyms: 猪八戒喝磨刀水——内秀（锈）
属臭豆腐的——闻着臭，吃着香

meaning.en: Extremely worn out, tattered or broken.
meaning.zh: 破旧得不成样子。

examples.zh: 他穿着一件破烂不堪的外套。
examples.en: He was wearing a coat that was in tatters.

examples.zh: 这辆自行车已经破烂不堪了。
examples.en: This bike is falling to pieces.

examples.zh: 村里的小学校舍破烂不堪。
examples.en: The village school buildings were badly run down.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Cf. 破败不堪 (dilapidated, of buildings).

meaning.en: Too shameful or underhand to be revealed.
meaning.zh: 不能告诉别人，多指有见不得人的意图或隐私。

examples.zh: 他这样做一定有不可告人的目的。
examples.en: He must have an ulterior motive for doing this.

examples.zh: 这家公司藏着什么不可告人的秘密？
examples.en: What dark secret is this company hiding?

examples.zh: 两人之间有不可告人的交易。
examples.en: There's some shady deal between the two of them.

usage.en: Attributive; often 不可告人的目的/秘密.
usage.zh: 多作定语，常说“不可告人的目的”。

meaning.en: To handle a familiar task with ease.
meaning.zh: 赶着轻车走熟路，比喻对事情熟悉，做起来容易。

examples.zh: 这种活儿他干了十年，早已驾轻就熟。
examples.en: He's done this kind of work for ten years and knows the ropes.

examples.zh: 她做主持人驾轻就熟。
examples.en: Hosting comes easily to her.

examples.zh: 刚开始很难，现在已经驾轻就熟了。
examples.en: It was hard at first, but now it's second nature.

story.en: Han Yu praised a scholar's skill as being 'like a team of four horses drawing a light carriage along a familiar road' (若驷马驾轻车就熟路).
story.zh: 韩愈《送石处士序》：“若驷马驾轻车就熟路，而王良、造父为之先后也。”

meaning.en: A life-and-death struggle in which only one side can survive.
meaning.zh: 形容斗争非常激烈，不是你死，就是我活。

examples.zh: 两家公司斗得你死我活。
examples.en: The two companies are locked in a cut-throat battle.

examples.zh: 比赛而已，没必要争得你死我活。
examples.en: It's only a game — no need to fight to the death.

examples.zh: 这是一场你死我活的较量。
examples.en: This is a life-and-death contest.

usage.en: Complement or attributive; often 斗得你死我活.
usage.zh: 多作补语、定语，常说“斗得你死我活”。

synonyms: 不是东风压倒西风，就是西风压倒东风

natural: separated only by a narrow strip of water

meaning.en: Separated only by a narrow strip of water; close neighbours.
meaning.zh: 像一条衣带那样窄的水，比喻仅隔一水，往来方便。

equivalents: separated only by a narrow strip of water

examples.zh: 中日两国是一衣带水的邻邦。
examples.en: China and Japan are neighbours separated only by a narrow strip of water.

examples.zh: 两岸一衣带水，往来十分方便。
examples.en: The two shores are just across the water from each other, making travel easy.

examples.zh: 这两个城市一衣带水，经济联系紧密。
examples.en: The two cities face each other across the water and have close economic ties.

story.en: Planning to conquer the Chen across the Yangtze, Emperor Wen of Sui said: 'I am father and mother to the people — how can a strip of water no wider than a belt stop me from saving them?' (岂可限一衣带水不拯之乎).
story.zh: 《南史·陈后主纪》：隋文帝谓仆射高颎曰：“我为百姓父母，岂可限一衣带水不拯之乎？”

usage.en: Attributive; often 一衣带水的邻邦. Formal/diplomatic.
usage.zh: 多作定语，常说“一衣带水的邻邦”，多用于外交辞令。

meaning.en: Unwilling to part or leave, out of deep attachment.
meaning.zh: 形容非常留恋，舍不得离开。

examples.zh: 孩子们恋恋不舍地和老师告别。
examples.en: The children said goodbye to their teacher reluctantly.

examples.zh: 假期结束了，大家都恋恋不舍。
examples.en: The holiday is over, and no one wants to leave.

examples.zh: 他恋恋不舍地看了老房子最后一眼。
examples.en: He took one last lingering look at the old house.

meaning.en: Covered all over in wounds.
meaning.zh: 浑身是伤，伤痕像鱼鳞一样密。

examples.zh: 他被打得遍体鳞伤。
examples.en: He was beaten black and blue.

examples.zh: 救出来的小狗遍体鳞伤。
examples.en: The rescued puppy was covered in wounds.

examples.zh: 一场失败的婚姻让她心里遍体鳞伤。
examples.en: A failed marriage left her emotionally battered.

usage.en: Complement or predicate; often 打得遍体鳞伤.
usage.zh: 多作补语、谓语，常说“打得遍体鳞伤”。

meaning.en: Alternating between cold and hot; (of attitudes) changeable and inconsistent.
meaning.zh: 一会儿冷一会儿热，形容天气多变，也形容态度时好时坏。

examples.zh: 最近天气忽冷忽热，容易感冒。
examples.en: The weather keeps going hot and cold, so it's easy to catch a cold.

examples.zh: 他对我忽冷忽热，我搞不懂他。
examples.en: He blows hot and cold with me; I can't figure him out.

examples.zh: 她学习的热情忽冷忽热。
examples.en: Her enthusiasm for study comes and goes.

meaning.en: Glowing with energy and vitality.
meaning.zh: 形容精神饱满，容光焕发。

examples.zh: 八十岁的老人依然神采奕奕。
examples.en: At eighty, the old man still radiates energy.

examples.zh: 她神采奕奕地走上了讲台。
examples.en: She stepped onto the stage glowing with energy.

examples.zh: 度假回来，他显得神采奕奕。
examples.en: Back from holiday, he looks full of life.
